description:
This process begins when a customer searches for a flight, train, or bus ticket.
After selecting the preferred route, date, and time, the customer provides personal information and payment details.
The booking system generates a ticket, which is sent to the customer via email or SMS.
The travel company updates its seat inventory accordingly.
Before travel, the customer may receive reminders and instructions for check-in or boarding.
The process concludes once the customer completes their journey, though post-travel feedback or services may extend it slightly.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_TicketBooking" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/ticket-booking">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Search" name="Ticket search request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_RouteOptions" name="Route options"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_RouteSelected" name="Route, date and time selected"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_DetailsProvided" name="Personal and payment details provided"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Ticket" name="Ticket"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Reminder" name="Travel reminder and check-in or boarding instructions"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_JourneyCompleted" name="Journey completed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Feedback" name="Post-travel feedback or service request"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_TicketBooking">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_TravelCompany" name="Travel Company" processRef="Process_TravelCompany"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Search" name="Search request" sourceRef="Task_SearchTicket" targetRef="StartEvent_Search" messageRef="Msg_Search"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_RouteOptions" name="Route options" sourceRef="Task_ShowRoutes" targetRef="Task_SelectRoute" messageRef="Msg_RouteOptions"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_RouteSelected" name="Route, date and time" sourceRef="Task_SelectRoute" targetRef="Catch_RouteSelected" messageRef="Msg_RouteSelected"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_DetailsProvided" name="Personal and payment details" sourceRef="Task_ProvideDetails" targetRef="Catch_DetailsProvided" messageRef="Msg_DetailsProvided"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Ticket" name="Ticket" sourceRef="Task_SendTicket" targetRef="Catch_TicketReceived" messageRef="Msg_Ticket"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Reminder" name="Reminder and instructions" sourceRef="Task_SendReminders" targetRef="Catch_ReminderReceived" messageRef="Msg_Reminder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_JourneyCompleted" name="Journey completed" sourceRef="Task_CompleteJourney" targetRef="Catch_JourneyCompleted" messageRef="Msg_JourneyCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Feedback" name="Post-travel feedback" sourceRef="Task_GiveFeedback" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFeedback" messageRef="Msg_Feedback"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer Ticket Journey" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_CustomerSearch" name="Ticket search started"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SearchTicket" name="Search for flight, train or bus ticket"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectRoute" name="Select route, date and time"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProvideDetails" name="Provide personal and payment details"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_TicketReceived" name="Ticket received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_TicketReceived" messageRef="Msg_Ticket"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_ReminderReceived" name="Reminder and instructions received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ReminderReceived" messageRef="Msg_Reminder"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CompleteJourney" name="Complete journey"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Feedback_Split" name="Give feedback or use services?" default="SF_C09"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_GiveFeedback" name="Give post-travel feedback or use services"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Feedback_Join" name="Merge feedback outcome"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CustomerJourney" name="Journey concluded"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_C01" sourceRef="Start_CustomerSearch" targetRef="Task_SearchTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_C02" sourceRef="Task_SearchTicket" targetRef="Task_SelectRoute"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_C03" sourceRef="Task_SelectRoute" targetRef="Task_ProvideDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_C04" sourceRef="Task_ProvideDetails" targetRef="Catch_TicketReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_C05" sourceRef="Catch_TicketReceived" targetRef="Catch_ReminderReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_C06" sourceRef="Catch_ReminderReceived" targetRef="Task_CompleteJourney"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_C07" sourceRef="Task_CompleteJourney" targetRef="Gateway_Feedback_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_C08" sourceRef="Gateway_Feedback_Split" targetRef="Task_GiveFeedback">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${feedbackProvided}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_C09" sourceRef="Gateway_Feedback_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Feedback_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_C10" sourceRef="Task_GiveFeedback" targetRef="Gateway_Feedback_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_C11" sourceRef="Gateway_Feedback_Join" targetRef="End_CustomerJourney"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_TravelCompany" name="Travel Company Ticket Booking" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Search" name="Ticket search received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Search" messageRef="Msg_Search"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ShowRoutes" name="Show flight, train and bus options"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_RouteSelected" name="Route, date and time selected">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_RouteSelected" messageRef="Msg_RouteSelected"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_DetailsProvided" name="Personal and payment details received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_DetailsProvided" messageRef="Msg_DetailsProvided"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenerateTicket" name="Generate ticket"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Ticket_Split" name="Split after ticket generation"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTicket" name="Send ticket via email or SMS" messageRef="Msg_Ticket"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_UpdateInventory" name="Update seat inventory"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Ticket_Join" name="Join after ticket and inventory update"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendReminders" name="Send reminders and check-in or boarding instructions" messageRef="Msg_Reminder"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_JourneyCompleted" name="Journey completed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_JourneyCompleted" messageRef="Msg_JourneyCompleted"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Feedback_Split" name="Feedback or service request given?" default="SF_T14"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveFeedback" name="Receive post-travel feedback or service request" messageRef="Msg_Feedback"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Feedback_Join" name="Merge feedback outcome"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Concluded" name="Booking concluded"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_T01" sourceRef="StartEvent_Search" targetRef="Task_ShowRoutes"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_T02" sourceRef="Task_ShowRoutes" targetRef="Catch_RouteSelected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_T03" sourceRef="Catch_RouteSelected" targetRef="Catch_DetailsProvided"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_T04" sourceRef="Catch_DetailsProvided" targetRef="Task_GenerateTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_T05" sourceRef="Task_GenerateTicket" targetRef="Gateway_Ticket_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_T06" sourceRef="Gateway_Ticket_Split" targetRef="Task_SendTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_T07" sourceRef="Gateway_Ticket_Split" targetRef="Task_UpdateInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_T08" sourceRef="Task_SendTicket" targetRef="Gateway_Ticket_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_T09" sourceRef="Task_UpdateInventory" targetRef="Gateway_Ticket_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_T10" sourceRef="Gateway_Ticket_Join" targetRef="Task_SendReminders"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_T11" sourceRef="Task_SendReminders" targetRef="Catch_JourneyCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_T12" sourceRef="Catch_JourneyCompleted" targetRef="Gateway_Feedback_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_T13" sourceRef="Gateway_Feedback_Split" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFeedback">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${feedbackProvided}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_T14" sourceRef="Gateway_Feedback_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Feedback_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_T15" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveFeedback" targetRef="Gateway_Feedback_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_T16" sourceRef="Gateway_Feedback_Join" targetRef="EndEvent_Concluded"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
